`speech.wav`: first six seconds of `tools/mtmd/test-2.mp3` from the pinned
llama.cpp fork (`442b0444168a0f72788b40a16c8289bd1eb217f5`), converted to mono
24 kHz PCM16. The opening says “The New York Times from July 21st 1969 …”.
Used only for real audio-input regression checks. See llama.cpp's MIT license.

Image fixtures are generated in memory by `scripts/validate_multimodal.py`.
